findings.claim: The accept list refuses "La Vigne Blanche", which is the land-registry name (lieu-dit) of the vineyard the question asks for. The question is exact-match only (ex:1), and after norm() strips the article that answer becomes "vigne blanche", which matches no entry.
findings.finalFix: Add to accept: "la vigne blanche", "vigne blanche"

findings.claim: The stem says Bouzeron 'insists on' the golden-berried form of Aligote, and the explanation says Bouzeron's rules were written around the golden strain.
findings.finalFix: Stem: "Bouzeron's growers favour one of Aligote's two forms, the golden-berried and lower-yielding one, though the appellation rules name only Aligote. Name it." Last sentence of the explanation: "The appellation rules say only Aligote, but Bouzeron's leading growers chose the golden strain to make the case that Aligote can be a serious wine."
